name: Recycling
highLevelGoals: The User aims to quickly find recycling facilities in their vicinity by searching with a zip code and viewing their locations on a map.
The User seeks to view operational hours, types of waste accepted, and other relevant details for each recycling facility.
The User desires to be informed about upcoming recycling events, special waste drop-off sites, and public recycling bins in their area.
The User wants to create an account, save favorite facilities, and potentially receive recommendations based on their schedule and waste types.
The User aims to easily contact administrators for feedback, questions, or assistance regarding the application or recycling services.
The User expects the system to securely store and manage their personal information and credentials to prevent identity theft or harassment.
The Administrator aims to add, remove, and update recycling facility information to ensure users have access to the most current details.
The Administrator seeks to read and categorize user feedback and complaints to identify areas for service improvement and new feature development.
The Administrator aims to establish and maintain direct communication channels with recycling facility representatives to update them on features and address concerns.
The Facility Representative aims to independently update their facility's details, such as accepted materials and operational hours, to ensure accuracy for users.
The Facility Representative seeks a direct channel to communicate any problems or concerns they have with the site administrators for resolution.
The Superuser aims to have the authority to update recycling center information, ensuring the latest details are available to users.
The Superuser seeks to formulate and send answers to user questions related to recycling centers, providing timely and accurate information.
The Company aims to provide and organize content and information displayed on the website, including uploading and deleting materials, to ensure relevance and accuracy.
lowLevelGoals: The system should provide an input field for users to enter a zip code and initiate a search for nearby recycling facilities.
The system should render the locations of recycling facilities found based on the zip code search on a map interface.
The system should allow users to interact with map markers to reveal more information about a specific recycling facility.
The system should provide a clickable address for a facility that, when activated, opens Google Maps with the facility's location.
The system should provide options for users to select specific waste types and display only facilities that accept those materials.
The system should render the locations of public recycling bins on a map interface.
The system should render the locations and details of safe disposal events on a map interface.
The system should render the locations of environment-friendly facilities on a map interface.
The system should fetch and present the opening and closing times for a specific recycling facility.
The system should fetch and present a list of materials that a specific recycling facility accepts.
The system should fetch and present contact details, such as phone number or email, for a specific recycling facility.
The system should provide an option for users to opt-in to receive alerts about local recycling events.
The system should automatically dispatch alerts to subscribed users regarding new or upcoming recycling events.
The system should present information about locations designated for special waste disposal.
The system should provide a registration interface for users to create a new profile.
The system should provide a login interface for users to access their profiles.
The system should enable users to mark specific recycling facilities for quick access in their profile.
The system should provide an interface for users to input their weekly availability to receive tailored recycling facility recommendations.
The system should analyze user-saved preferences, waste types, and uploaded schedules to suggest relevant recycling facilities.
The system should provide a mechanism for users to earn points or badges for their recycling efforts and view their reward progress.
The system should offer a dedicated form for users to send messages to administrators.
The system should present a collection of frequently asked questions and their solutions to users.
The system should provide access to comprehensive documentation explaining how to use various features of the application.
The system should provide a mechanism for users to request a password reset, sending a secure link to their registered email address.
The system should inform users when an entered zip code is invalid or not found.
The system should provide an interface for administrators to input and save details for new recycling facilities.
The system should provide an interface for administrators to modify details of existing recycling facilities.
The system should provide an interface for administrators to delete recycling facility entries.
The system should present a list of all submitted user feedback and complaints to administrators.
The system should provide tools for administrators to assign categories to incoming user feedback.
The system should enable administrators to update the status of user feedback items.
The system should offer an internal communication tool for administrators to send messages to facility representatives.
The system should enable administrators to broadcast messages to all registered facility representatives.
The system should provide an interface for facility representatives to modify the opening and closing times of their facility.
The system should provide an interface for facility representatives to modify the list of materials their facility accepts.
The system should provide an interface for facility representatives to modify the contact details of their facility.
The system should offer a specific communication method for facility representatives to report problems or concerns to administrators.
The system should enable facility representatives to track the progress or resolution of issues they have reported.
The system should provide an interface with elevated permissions for superusers to modify details of any recycling center.
The system should provide a mechanism for superusers to review and decide on changes submitted by facility representatives.
The system should present a list of all questions submitted by users to superusers.
The system should provide an interface for superusers to write and send responses to user questions.
The system should enable superusers to update the status of user questions once they have been answered.
The system should provide an interface for the company to add new informational or media content to the website.
The system should provide an interface for the company to remove outdated or irrelevant content from the website.
The system should provide tools for the company to structure and categorize the content displayed on the website.
